newsitem.title: USA: Cascade Financial to take Q1 charge.
newsitem.headline: Cascade Financial to take Q1 charge.

text.p: Cascade Financial Corp, the holding company for Cascade Savings Bank, will report a pretax first quarter charge of $1.2 million relating to the Federal government's legislation to combine the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's (FDIC) two insurance funds.
Chairman Frank McCord said, however, that the legislation will have long-term benefits because deposit insurance premiums will decrease substantially.
Beginning in 1997, this annual pre-tax savings should amount to approximately $450,000, he said.
